symptom: Every **annotation on a domain model** — the note boxes Studio Pro draws on the canvas — disappears when anything rewrites that domain model on `--engine legacy`. Adding one entity to a blank app's MyFirstModule takes its annotation count from 1 to 0 and the caption vanishes from the project. `mx check` reports **0 errors**: an annotation is decorative, so nothing below Studio Pro can see the loss. The default (modelsdk) engine preserves them
cause: Two defects. (1) `sdk/mpr/writer_domainmodel.go` hardcoded `{Key: "Annotations", Value: bson.A{int32(3)}}` — the bare empty typed array — regardless of what the domain model held, while the parser read them into `dm.Annotations` perfectly well. (2) `parseAnnotation` read `Location` only as a BSON sub-document, but Studio Pro stores it as the **string** `"60;240"`, the same convention an entity's Location uses — so even before the write threw them away, every position had already read back as (0,0), and `Width` was never read at all
insight: **A collection the parser reads but the writer hardcodes is invisible to every round-trip test that only checks the parser.** Grep the writers for `bson.A{int32(3)}` written as a literal value rather than built from a slice — that shape is the bug. **A blank Mendix app is a free reference document**: MyFirstModule ships with a real Studio Pro-authored annotation, which is where the `"x;y"` string shape came from — no need to ask anyone to author one. There is **no colour property**: a domain model holds exactly four child collections (Annotations, Associations, CrossAssociations, Entities) and `DomainModels$Annotation` is Caption/ExportLevel/Location/Width, so a "coloured section box" is this element in Studio Pro's own styling, not stored state. A test fixture ID must be a **real UUID** — `idToBsonBinary` cannot round-trip a made-up string, which reads as an identity bug that isn't one
